70112233.title: Book Lovers (novel)
70112233.extract: Book Lovers is a 2022 romance novel by American author Emily Henry. It follows Nora Stephens, a literary agent from New York City, who spends a summer in the small town of Sunshine Falls, North Carolina, with her sister and keeps running into her professional rival, the editor Charlie Lastra.

1001.title: Book Lovers
1001.extract: Book Lovers may refer to: Book Lovers (novel), a 2022 novel by Emily Henry; Book lovers, people who love books.

2002.title: Emily Henry
2002.extract: Emily Henry is an American author of romance novels, including Beach Read, People We Meet on Vacation and Book Lovers, all of them bestsellers.
